Principal Associate, Data Scientist - SBB Marketing & Deposit Strategy

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Small businesses make up 99% of U.S. firms and drive 44% of the nation's GDP. At Small Business Bank (SBB), our mission is to advocate for these entrepreneurs and empower their long-term success. The SBB Data Science team brings a relentless focus to the craft of data science—spanning statistics, machine learning, and emerging AI technologies. We partner across the organization to optimize the performance and impact of the financial products, policies, and services delivered to our customers.

Role Description

In this role, you will:
• Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
• Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
• Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
• Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals
• Develop modeling solutions and conduct analyses to drive customer engagement, improve retention, and elevate the overall customer experience

The Ideal Candidate is:
• Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
• Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and back tested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
• A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.
• Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.

Basic Qualifications:
• Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
• A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 5 years of experience performing data analytics
• A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 3 years of experience performing data analytics
• A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field)

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analytics, or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
• At least 3 years’ experience with machine learning and statistical modeling
• At least 3 years’ experience in Python, Dask, Spark etc.
• At least 3 years’ experience with SQL
• At least 1 year of experience working with AWS
• At least 1 year of experience with deep learning/emerging AI e.g. graphs, embeddings, sequence models, or transformer models

About The Role

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers travel for some of the world's largest brands through our APIs, white label products and fintech, and every dataset we hold tells a story our partners need told clearly, repeatedly and fast. As a Senior Data Scientist on HTS you will own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of partners and build the machinery that answers their questions about supply health, pricing competitiveness and performance once, then answers them every week. You will be judged less on the sophistication of your models than on whether the people you work with, inside Hopper and across partner commercial teams, make better decisions because of you.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

• Own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of HTS partners, working alongside Partner Success and Commercial to understand what they need, deliver it, and present it directly to their teams
• Design and templatize repeatable reporting on supply health, pricing competitiveness and tenant performance that scales across hotels, flights, homes and cars without being rebuilt each time
• Use AI assistants, agents and code generation tools as everyday collaborators to automate the repetitive parts of analysis and reporting, and help the broader team adopt the same practices
• Frame and run exploratory analyses that deepen our understanding of partner and traveler behavior, and translate what you find into clear recommendations for product, engineering and business leaders
• Apply machine learning and statistical methods to large, messy datasets where they move the needle, and recognize when a simple, well explained metric is the better answer
• Build dashboards and self serve reporting in BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude and Google Sheets, with an eye toward making yourself unnecessary for routine questions
• Partner closely with product and engineering so the data we collect supports the questions our partners will ask next

An ideal candidate has

• A degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience
• Extremely strong analytical and problem solving skills, with a track record of answering hard questions with data across more than one domain or product line
• A proven ability to turn complex technical work into simple, credible narratives for non technical and executive audiences, including external partners
• Comfort being partner facing, presenting findings, fielding tough questions live and building trust with commercial counterparts
• Deep SQL skills and experience with modern data warehouses such as BigQuery, plus fluency in Python and Pandas or R for large scale data preparation and analysis
• Hands on, daily use of LLM based tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Copilot for writing code, SQL, analysis and documentation, and a point of view on where they help and where they fall short
• Experience building or deploying automated and agentic workflows, from scheduled pipelines to LLM driven report generation and prompt or skill libraries, that turn one off analyses into repeatable products
• Experience with data mining, machine learning and statistical modeling, and the judgment to know when to reach for them
• Experience with business reporting and experimentation tools such as Tableau, Looker or Amplitude
• A strong bias toward simplifying, templatizing and shipping over polishing
• Travel industry experience in lodging, air, vacation rentals or car rental, or in a marketplace, B2B platform or API distribution business, is a plus
• Experience with geographic data in search, filtering or recommendation, or working with external customers in a consulting, solutions or customer analytics capacity, is a plus

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

• Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages
• Unlimited PTO
• Carrot Cash travel stipend
• Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend
• Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!
• Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
• Open communication with management and company leadership
• Small, dynamic teams = massive impact
• 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees
• Access to Disability & Life insurance

About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What That Looks Like In Practice

• Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year.
• Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.
• Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again.
• HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled.
• Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company's fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal.

Come take off with us!

Description
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd

Office of the Managing Director and Chief Knowledge Officer

The Managing Director and Chief Knowledge Officer (MDCKO) oversees the World Bank Group's knowledge and partnership agenda and helps ensure that the institution's analytical and operational work responds to the most pressing development challenges facing client countries and global partners. The office plays a key role in shaping the WBG's strategic direction, supporting key partnerships with shareholders, development agen-cies, academia, and other stakeholders, and strengthening how knowledge, evidence, and learning inform de-velopment impact. With the launch of the Knowledge Bank at the start of 2026, the WBG is deepening its fo-cus on one of the areas client countries value most: global knowledge on what works, where, and why. The Knowledge Bank is intended to bring global expertise closer to country challenges, strengthen collaboration across sectors and institutions, and help scale practical solutions that can improve lives, create jobs, and sup-port better development outcomes.

As part of this model, the WBG now operates through five vertical vice presidencies aligned with the mission: People, Prosperity, Planet, Infrastructure, and Digital & AI. In addition, three horizontal departments report-ing to the MDCKO enhance knowledge, innovation, and outcome orientation across the WBG. One of those horizontal departments focuses on improving the institution's outcome orientation: the Department for Out-comes.
About the Department for Outcomes

The Department for Outcomes is a corporate delivery and change team at the center of the World Bank Group's shift from measuring activity to managing for impact. Its mandate is to make outcomes visible, com-parable, and actionable so that leaders and teams can understand where the institution is changing lives, where progress is off track, and what needs to change next.

The Department leads the implementation of the World Bank Group Scorecard as an accountability, manage-ment, and communications tool. It develops and improves outcome indicators, methodologies, and targets in areas such as jobs, climate, private capital, gender, and youth; provides quality assurance; and connects out-come ambitions to knowledge, operations, and financing. Through its Outcome Measurement and Outcome Delivery units, the Department combines corporate reporting with portfolio analytics, forecasting, regular stocktakes, and action planning across the World Bank, IFC, and MIGA.

The Department also has a growing global role. It convenes multilateral development banks, development agencies, researchers, and external experts to improve and align outcome approaches, build institutional ca-pacity, and modernize the profession of results measurement. Its work reaches from project-level data to sen-ior management decisions, and from new methodologies inside the World Bank Group to shared approaches across the international development system.

Technology and innovation are core to how the team works. The Department develops AI-enabled analytics, data pipelines, forecasting models, interactive visualizations, and decision-support products that turn large and complex datasets into clear choices for operational teams, senior management, and external stakeholders. A piece of analysis is not considered finished when it is technically correct; it is finished when it helps im-prove a decision, a process, or a development outcome.

The culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and demanding. The team moves quickly because the needs are urgent, tests ideas early, learns from users, improves continuously, and expects high standards from concept through delivery. It values intellectual curiosity, rigorous analysis, direct communication, ownership, thoughtful risk-taking, and the readiness to challenge established practices. Young talent has been a major source of the Department's innovation and rapid delivery; the selected Data Scientist ETC will be expected not only to contribute to the agenda but to help shape it.

Position Context

The Department for Outcomes is seeking dynamic, versatile Data Scientist Extended Term Consultants (ETCs) who operate fluently across code, evidence, strategy, and executive delivery. The successful candi-date will combine strong data science and quantitative research skills with knowledge of development opera-tions and a passion for evidence-informed decision-making and institutional change. The position offers di-rect exposure to corporate strategy, high-level leadership decision-making, and the global ecosystem of mul-tilateral development banks (MDBs).

This single selection process is designed to select and hire up to four (04) Data Scientist ETCs, subject to candidate profile, technical screening, and interview evaluations. Selected candidates will be mapped across workstreams within the Outcome Measurement and Outcome Delivery units, based on business needs.

Selected consultants will join the team on-site at WBG Headquarters in Washington, D.C.

What You’ll Deliver

The Data Scientist ETC will contribute across analytical, technical, and operational workstreams:
• Indicator Methodology, Design & Quality Assurance: Support the development, testing, and refinement of outcome indicators and methodologies at both the project and portfolio level. This includes end-to-end data collection, data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and rigorous quality assurance of WBG Scorecard indicators, as well as conducting manual and automated reviews of results frameworks in operational pro-ject documents (e.g., Project Appraisal Documents [PADs], Implementation Status and Results Reports [ISRs], and Implementation Completion and Results Reports [ICRs]) when required.
• Outcome Targets & Predictive Forecasting: Support the formulation and regular monitoring of out-come targets to inform evidence-based decisions on corporate strategies and operational portfolios. Re-sponsibilities include in-depth reviews of strategy and project documentation, curation of outcome da-tasets, application of statistical and forecasting techniques to project future portfolio-level trajectories, and synthesis of strategic findings.
• AI for Outcomes Engineering & Tool Development: Actively contribute to the AI for Outcomes pro-gram by designing, building, evaluating, and maintaining analytical tools, data pipelines, and intelligent products. This includes engineering applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), natural language processing (NLP), and machine learning to strengthen outcomes measurement, extract opera-tional insights from unstructured text, and support evidence-based decision-making.
• Methodological Notes & Guidance Development: Author and contribute to methodological notes, indi-cator reference sheets, and technical guidance documents. Ensure quality assurance of results data by drawing on leading research and evaluation methods used across MDBs and international partners, di-rectly strengthening the credibility, consistency, and comparability of reported outcomes.
• Portfolio Analytics & Strategic Executive Insights: Analyze outcome metrics from across WBG opera-tions, aggregate portfolio results, and monitor where and how the institution is delivering on its develop-ment commitments. Extract actionable insights and strategic signals to feed into corporate decision-support platforms utilized by WBG Senior Leadership.
• Executive Visualization & Strategic Communication: Translate complex, multidimensional analytical and econometric findings into clear, visually compelling, and consulting-style deliverables. This includes crafting high-level executive slide decks, briefs, interactive dashboards, talking points, and briefing memos tailored for senior management, technical peers, and non-specialist audiences.
• Thematic Workstreams & Action Plans: Contribute to the rollout of outcome-related corporate action plans and cross-cutting thematic work (such as jobs, climate, private capital mobilization, women, and youth) in close collaboration with Regional operational teams, vertical Vice Presidencies, IFC, and MI-GA.
• Stakeholder Convening & Global Partnerships: Support the Department’s convening, learning, and ca-pacity-building engagements with internal and external stakeholders, including working groups with oth-er multilateral development banks, partner development agencies, academic experts, and external adviso-ry bodies such as the Jobs Council.
• Workstream & Project Management: Provide proactive project management support across analytical workstreams, including scoping tasks, coordinating inputs from multidisciplinary teams, tracking mile-stones, managing delivery timelines, and ensuring outputs meet the highest standards of technical rigor.
• Ad-Hoc Program Delivery: Contribute flexibly to additional emerging work program priorities, rapid-response analytical requests, and corporate initiatives of the Department for Outcomes as needed.

Selection Criteria
What You’ll Bring
Education:
• Minimum of a master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Applied Mathe-matics, Information Systems, Public Policy, Public Administration, International Development, Business Management, or a closely related quantitative field, ideally with a strong concentration in analytics. A Ph.D. is strongly preferred.
Professional Experience:
• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in data science, analytics, results measurement, monitoring and evaluation (M&E), portfolio management, management consulting, development finance, or public policy.
• Prior experience in management consulting or portfolio management with direct exposure to senior exec-utive audiences is a distinct advantage.
• Proven ability to bridge the gap between technical code, data pipelines, and strategic business value for institutional decision-makers.
Technical & Methodological Competencies:
• Programming & Modeling: High proficiency in Python and SQL (proficiency in R and/or Stata is also an asset). Strong applied knowledge of statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, NLP, and modern LLM application workflows.
• Data Engineering & Workflow Discipline: Working knowledge of modern software engineering best practices (version control with Git, modular code architecture, rigorous testing, and reproducible analyti-cal workflows). Experience processing structured and unstructured datasets, interacting with APIs, man-aging relational databases, and conducting data quality validation. Experience deploying interactive dashboards or end-to-end data pipelines is an advantage.
• Research, Indicators & Evaluation: Solid understanding of empirical research, indicator development, evidence sources, and evaluation methodologies, including approaches standard across MDBs and inter-national organizations.
• Operational Literacy: Familiarity with development operations, operational project cycles (PADs, ISRs, ICRs), results measurement frameworks, or the WBG Scorecard is an advantage.
• Visualization & Communication: Advanced skills in data visualization and executive presentation (in-cluding high proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint), with a demonstrated knack for structuring complex data into clean, executive-ready visual narratives.
Behavioral & Interpersonal Competencies:
• Integrative & Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated capacity to synthesize disparate technical, operational, and qualitative inputs from across sectoral boundaries into an integrated institutional perspective.
• Client Orientation & Delivery Under Pressure: High sense of ownership, adaptability, and an outside-in mindset capable of prioritizing and delivering high-quality products under tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Teamwork & Collaboration: Demonstrated success collaborating effectively in diverse, multicultural, multidisciplinary teams, serving as an effective bridge between technical engineers and operational spe-cialists.
• Language Skills: Full professional fluency in English (verbal and written) is required. Working profi-ciency in another official WBG language (French, Spanish, Arabic, Russian, or Chinese) is an asset.

What are Trust Fund Positions?

Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. OVERVIEW
This position is located in Washington, DC, within the Forest Global Earth Observatory (ForestGEO), Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute (STRI), under the Office of the Under Secretary for Science and Research at the Smithsonian Institution (SI).

STRI provides a global platform for research on tropical forests and marine ecosystems, biodiversity, and human well-being.

The ForestGEO program is a global network of scientists and forest research sites dedicated to advancing the long-term study of the world's forests.

The GEO-TREES initiative builds on this network to improve the accuracy and verification of global forest carbon estimates through collaboration among forest research sites worldwide. The Data Scientist supports the Forest Global Earth Observatory (ForestGEO) and GEO-TREES programs as a liaison between site-based data collection and the development of analytical data products.
